title.en: Object-swap instructions use each reference according to its role
title.zh: 对象交换按参考内容判断用途，不再默认换人

summary.en: The revised object-swap instructions ask the generation model to map all images to the original video for people, clothing or objects, without an extra recognition model or target-selection step. Existing framing, duration and billing rules remain in force.
summary.zh: 修订后的对象交换指令由生成模型结合全部图片与原视频判断人物、服饰或物品的合理对应，无额外识别模型或目标点选；沿用既有画幅、时长与计费规则。

body.en:
The revised default object-swap instructions ask the video-generation model to interpret the original video and all reference images. Image order identifies references rather than forcing image 1 to replace a person. A personal prompt is optional; no separate recognition model or target-selection step is added.

The instructions distinguish identity, clothing, objects and local appearance. They prioritize the complete primary subject and its intended role, favor a reasonable target of the same type and function, and minimize unrelated changes among equally good matches. When such a same-type target exists, they do not switch to an unrelated category. For identity replacement, the instructions use the reference's visible face, hair, body structure, build and clothing; body or clothing not shown in the reference follows the original video, and an outfit-only change does not count as identity replacement. Clothing-only or object-only swaps retain the original person's identity, body and the style, colors and materials of other clothing. Multiple views describe the same object without increasing its count. The instructions replace the original target with the reference's shape, structure, style and visible details, including sleeve length and cut for clothing. Only scale, perspective, lighting, folds and necessary contact may adapt, while unrelated content, actions, camera sequence, timing and original sound are requested to stay consistent. Reference colors and materials apply only to selected targets; non-target objects keep their original colors, materials and transparency instead of inheriting the target's appearance. These are generation goals, not a guarantee of exact preservation or correct interpretation on every request.

An explicitly supplied, valid personal supplement takes priority. In the workbench, the personal-prompt switch controls whether the draft is sent. Verified saved-character identity and species apply only when that image is actually used for identity. The current 10 built-in object-swap sidebar presets keep their visible descriptions and reference videos without sending their generic display sentence as a generation supplement. Explore application and community task descriptions retain their existing behavior.

The default instructions also affect the existing influencer video-creation integration; no public request or response fields change. This does not add a default prompt to arbitrary generic video requests. Standard-framing limits, positive whole-second requests and existing billing remain unchanged; the dedicated mode that automatically inherits original framing and duration is not enabled.

This entry describes the revised default instructions. Publishing this documentation does not establish that the production workbench has received the update; availability depends on the deployed site version.
body.zh:
本次对象交换默认指令调整为通用提示，让视频生成模型结合原视频与全部参考图片自行判断对应用途；图片顺序用于指代，不再强制图片 1 替换人物。个人提示词仍可留空，不增加额外识别模型或目标点选。

提示先理解参考图完整主要对象及表达用途，优先同类、同用途合理对应，同等匹配时再最小化无关变化；同类合理目标存在时不跨到无关类别。以人物身份为替换目标时，指令要求采用参考图可见的面容、发型、身体结构、体型与穿戴；图中未展示的身体或穿戴沿用原视频，不能仅换衣服当作换人。提示区分身份、服饰、物品与局部外观：仅交换服饰或物品时，保留使用者身份、身体及其他穿戴的款式、颜色与材质，同物多个角度不增加数量。指令要求以参考的形状、结构、款式与可见细节替换原目标，服饰袖长与剪裁按参考，仅适配尺度、透视、光照、衣褶及必要接触，同时要求无关内容、动作、镜头顺序、时序与原音保持一致。参考颜色与材质只作用于选定目标，非目标物品的颜色、材质与透明度须保持原视频，不随目标染色或替换材质。这些是生成目标，不保证每次都精确保留或正确理解对应关系。

有效且明确传入的个人补充优先；工作台个人提示开关决定是否发送草稿。已核验保存角色的身份与物种，仅在该图实际作为身份参考时适用。当前 10 项内置对象交换侧栏预设保留可见说明与参考视频，但不再把通用展示句作为生成补充发送；探索区应用及社区任务描述沿用原行为。

这些默认规则也影响既有角色视频创建集成入口，不改变公开请求或响应字段，也不会向任意通用视频请求自动添加默认提示。标准画幅限制、正整数秒请求与既有计费保持不变，仍未启用自动沿用原片画幅与时长的专用编辑方式。

本条记录说明修订后的默认指令。文档发布不代表生产工作台已更新，实际可用性以已部署的网站版本为准。
